  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 08, 2023 AT 5:00 PM
  CITY HALL EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER (EOC)
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at
(626) 300­0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.
CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor
Huang, and Mayor Talt

POSTING OF AGENDA

The special meeting agenda is posted 24 hours prior to each special meeting at the following
locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive,
and the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The special meeting agenda is also
posted on the City’s website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

  聖馬力諾市議會
  特別會議 2023 年 2 月 8 日（星期三）下午 5 時
  市政廳緊急運營中心（EOC），
  地址：2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

聖馬力諾市政府感謝您出席會議。公民參與為市議會提供了有關社區問題的寶貴資訊。

每個月的第二個星期三下午 6 時舉行例會。通常，延期舉行的會議在每個月的最後一個星期五上午 8:30
舉行。

根據《美國殘障人士法》，任何需要合理照顧或便利以參加會議的殘障人士應在會議前與市書記官聯繋，
請求協助，電子郵件：CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org；電話：(626) 300-0705。
宣佈開會

點名

市議員 Chou、市議員 Lo、市議員 Shepherd Romey、副市長 Huang 和市長 Talt

議程發佈

特別會議議程在每次特別會議前 24 小時張貼在以下地點：City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive；the
Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive；the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive
。特別會議議程還會發佈在本市網站上：http://www.cityofsanmarino.org。
